prompt.text:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE NEW original full-bleed landscape3:2 architectural/train scene illustration for a friendly casual mobile game. Rectangular opaque artwork only, no interface.
Primary request: a cheerful whimsical orange-and-pink brick railway station, a small toy-like steam TRAIN in front at the left, and green ANIMAL-SHAPED TOPIARY shrubs under a bright turquoise sky. Newly drawn scene from this concept, never a screenshot crop or screenshot assembly.
Architecture: the station is centered, seen from a very slightly elevated front three-quarter view. Warm orange brick walls with salmon-pink/peach stone pilasters and corner trim; a broad central arched stone entrance with a deep shaded warm doorway and a few cream steps; symmetrical side windows with rounded arch tops and pale gold trim; a simple muted plum-purple tiled roof and one slightly raised central gable. Readable rounded decorative architecture, small friendly proportions. The roof and facade have NO lettering, no signs, no clock digits, no emblems or crest. The center above the door is plain masonry. No moustache sculpture or roof ornament.
Train: along the lower left in front of the station, a compact dark navy/deep green steam locomotive with simple warm yellow-gold trim, rounded dark wheels, a short chimney and a simple cabin, plus a glimpse of one small purple-and-gold passenger carriage cropped at the far left. No symbols or logos on the engine or coach, no numbers, no faces, no passengers. A small soft white steam puff may rise beside the chimney without obscuring architecture.
Topiary: behind/left of the station a clipped rich green hedge shaped like a friendly sitting DOG with a clearly readable dog head and snout. Behind/right of the station a taller clipped green hedge shaped like a friendly upright RABBIT with two long upright ears. These are LEAFY PLANTS shaped like animals, not living characters or toys. Smooth softly textured foliage masses, gentle playful silhouettes. Keep them visible around both sides of the roof.
Environment and composition: bright flat turquoise/aqua sky with two soft white clouds, low rounded green background hills, short green lawn around the station, a pale grey platform/rail strip across the bottom. A little simple black iron garden fence and one plain platform lamp at the right may frame the scene. Station occupies the center two-thirds; train at lower left; dog topiary left and rabbit topiary right; full scenery fills every edge. The external artwork canvas is a plain rectangle, not a rounded or arched UI window. The building's central arch is only architectural masonry.
Style: polished colorful soft3D cartoon casual mobile-game illustration, bright warm welcoming sunlight, smooth rounded sculpted forms, clean readable silhouettes, cheerful toy-town scale and gentle internal/contact shading.
Text: NONE.
Hard constraints: NO UI whatsoever. No screenshot, no outer panel/frame/arched UI border, no title or caption, no labels, no letters, no M logo, no brand mark or emblem, no moustache logo/ornament, no digits/numbers, no station sign with text, no timer, no progress meter/bar/gauge, no rank list, no profile cards, no people portraits, no buttons, no X, no info symbol, no badges or reward items, no dice, no cash/banknotes, no card packs, no coins, no monkey icon, no floating particles or confetti, no watermark, no external UI cast/drop shadow. Do not add game-policy diagrams or interaction controls. Only the new standalone train-station environment scene.
